en.title: Stock Prices
en.description: Count the triplets of increasing indices (i,j,k) such that the sum of the prices on those three days is divisible by d. Different index combinations with the same prices are counted separately.
en.input: The first line contains n d; the second line contains n positive integer prices. Original constraints: n≤1000, price≤10^9, 2≤d≤10^6.
en.output: Output the number of index triplets that satisfy the condition.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definition, and watch the boundaries.
